successCriteria.description: A test exists (in tests/unit/shared/date.deduplication.test.ts or added to tests/unit/shared/date.test.ts) that sets process.env.TZ='Asia/Riyadh' in beforeAll and restores the original TZ in afterAll, and within that block asserts startOfUtcDay, addMonths, and periodContaining produce the expected UTC instants at a period boundary — specifically that periodContaining(anchor=Date.UTC(2023,0,10), 1, date=Date.UTC(2023,1,10)) returns start=Date.UTC(2023,1,10) and end=Date.UTC(2023,2,10) (the exclusive-end roll into the next period).

A source-level assertion reads src/modules/leave/leave.service.ts and src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts via fs and asserts neither file contains the substrings 'private startOfUtcDay', 'private addMonths', or 'private periodContaining', so a future re-introduced private copy fails the suite.

The new test imports the helpers from '../../../src/shared/date' (the public entry point) and does not modify any source file; npm run build is clean, the full unit suite passes, and npm run smoke passes every stage.

constraints: Do NOT modify any source file (src/**) — this phase is test-only.
Import the helpers from the public entry point '../../../src/shared/date' (src/shared/date/index.ts), not from src/shared/date/accrual.ts directly.
Match the existing TZ save/restore pattern: capture the original process.env.TZ, set it in beforeAll, restore it in afterAll.
The source-level assertion must target the exact substrings 'private startOfUtcDay', 'private addMonths', and 'private periodContaining' in both leave.service.ts and balance.service.ts.
outOfScope: Modifying any source file (src/**) — including the shared date module, leave.service.ts, balance.service.ts, repositories, routes, or DTOs.
Changing the arithmetic or behavior of startOfUtcDay, addMonths, or periodContaining.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The boundary-roll assertion must match the canonical periodContaining semantics in src/shared/date/accrual.ts: the period end is exclusive (date < end), so a date exactly at the period end rolls into the next period.

The TZ save/restore pattern and import path must match the existing pattern in tests/unit/shared/date.test.ts (import from '../../../src/shared/date'; capture originalTZ, set in beforeAll, restore in afterAll).

The source-level assertion must reflect the deduplication already completed in Phases 1 and 2: leave.service.ts and balance.service.ts import the helpers from '../../shared/date' and contain no private copies.
